services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Experience Edmonton’s early history with programs for learners of all ages and activities tailored to suit your group’s needs. From building a model tipi together in our 1846 Fort to preparing a tasty treat like the pioneers, we have something for every classroom! services.name: Day Camps
services.desc: Ready for a week of adventure? Day Camps are back at Fort Edmonton Park. Your child can now embark on a historic journey through our immersive, fun and unique summer programs. With four distinct eras and the new Indigenous Peoples Experience to explore, your camper will create lasting memories with new friends. Let your summer adventure begin! Please note: The City of Edmonton offers the option of Pre-Camp and Post-Camp Care during registration. Pre-Camp Care is from 8:00 am to 9:00 am, and Post-Camp Care is from 4:00 pm to 5:00 pm.
